title: Dress rehearsal
goalText: Match all 9 before moves run out.
coachText: Each swipe uses 1 move. Undo gives it back.

tutorial.title: Now you have a move limit.
paragraphs: Each swipe uses 1 move. Match all 9 items before the counter reaches zero.
Undo is free and gives that move back.
These practice levels give you plenty of room to try.
